site.name: Alaska Mine
overview: Alaska Mine is a named historic gold-, silver-, and lead-bearing mine in Chaffee County, preserved on U.S. topographic mapping in the Garfield quadrangle near the Monarch mining area.

timeline.text: Alaska Mine became an established named mine locality in the Garfield quadrangle and was retained in federal topographic feature records.

moreHistory: USGS-derived mapped-place records locate Alaska Mine at approximately 38.55916, -106.27697 and about 10,266 feet elevation, and describe the inactive mine as associated with silver, gold, and lead.
Available site-specific records support the mine's identity and location but do not provide a dependable detailed operating chronology or production history.
